summary.text: Tex Fischer is a Republican state representative from Ohio House of Representatives District 59 and is seeking re-election on the November 3, 2026 ballot. A political strategist by profession, he is vice chair of the Natural Resources Committee.

paragraphs.text: Fischer’s career experience includes working as a political strategist, according to Ballotpedia.
As the incumbent, he defeated Laura Schaeffer in the November 2024 general election for District 59.
In the 2025–2026 session he was assigned to the Commerce and Labor, Development, Energy, and Natural Resources (vice chair) committees.
